newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Rotterdam bunkers gain, Mediterranean dips.
newsitem.headline: Rotterdam bunkers gain, Mediterranean dips.

text.p: Rotterdam bunker prices gained by around $2 on Monday in line with barge market strength, while prices in southern Europe mostly dipped, dealers said.
Rotterdam 380 CST was quoted at $90/$92 fob after a couple of buyers in the barge market shunted prices higher, dealers said. Many said supply of running refinery and storage material remained good.
A major, one of the barge market buyers, offered bunkers aggressively, selling at $89 early.
Hamburg prices put on around $4 a tonne, partly to restore the usual Rotterdam/Hamburg differential.
However, it did little to encourage trade, apart from numerous small enquiries.
Mediterranean prices were about $1 a tonne lower as benchmark quotes dipped. The only exception was southern France where prices rose by $1/$2.
In Fujairah, suppliers held back from offering in the morning, eyeing price gains in the afternoon when they upped their offers, but failed to draw in buyers.
